listItems.nullableEncoding: For these two nullable fields only, the pinned JSONObject converter may omit a null value; canonical read may normalize absent and null to null. Do not invent an order or timestamp.
listItems.oracle: Compare the entire ordered persisted field sequence, every body occurrence count, and reconstructed parent/child groups against explicit before/after fixtures. Use distinct body markers for individually tracked tasks. For intentionally indistinguishable duplicate tuples, preserve multiplicity and position/group; do not claim durable identity across restart.

oraclePolicy.authority: Raw database/files/preferences/system snapshots acquired independently from the mutating app path. Paired screenshot/tree for visible outcomes.
oraclePolicy.database: Baseline NotallyDatabase/BaseNote and Label; inspect active storage location and encryption mode. Copy a coherent SQLite snapshot including WAL or use read-only transaction; never raw-copy main DB alone during writes.
oraclePolicy.target: runtime serial and actual built applicationId must be explicit in executor, not inferred from production ID.
oraclePolicy.failure: Missing artifact, unsupported oracle, permission denial or manual requirement stays in denominator as blocked/unverified; do not relabel as passed.

sourceEvidenceContract.workflow: Actual Intent exploration produces evidence; the Agent uses that evidence to author independent Script regression. The two runtimes are not coupled or auto-compiled by this plan.
sourceEvidenceContract.missing: Keep source fields empty until a real captured artifact exists; never derive provenance from source code or a planned command.
